style: landscape cleanup with controlled sky highlights, reduced haze, and natural tonal depth

image_observation.main_subject: coastal hillside and shoreline sweeping around the bay
supporting_elements: green field patterning on the hillside
distractions: gray atmospheric haze over the hill and cloud base
weak tonal separation between cloud shadow, ridge, and field texture
slightly chalky brightness in the upper frame
image_observation.tonal_state: the scene is veiled and low-clarity; structure is present but softened by haze
image_observation.color_state: greens and water are believable but a little washed by the atmospheric veil
image_observation.highlight_shadow_state: the cloud bank is bright and broad; highlight protection matters more than shadow lift
image_observation.composition_state: the composition is already clean and panoramic, so the edit should not pretend framing is the answer

vision_interpretation.user_goal: clean up the landscape, keep cloud highlights under control, and increase natural tonal depth
vision_interpretation.desired_viewer_first_read: coastline sweep first, then hillside patchwork and cloud structure
vision_interpretation.desired_mood: clearer Atlantic daylight, still honest about the weather and haze

control_selections.reason: Use the approved landscape tonal-depth preset as the safest available way to add hillside structure.
control_selections.expected_effect: better lower-midtone depth through fields and shoreline
control_selections.risk: haze transitions can feel too hard
control_selections.risk_mitigation: stay with the approved exact preset rather than inventing a stronger curve

control_selections.reason: Compress the brightest cloud values slightly so the ridge and cloud mass can coexist more cleanly.
control_selections.expected_effect: better cloud control with less chalky glare
control_selections.risk_mitigation: keep the setting moderate and avoid stacking too much local highlight processing

control_selections.reason: Start compression high enough to target the cloud bank rather than the whole frame.
control_selections.risk_mitigation: use conservatively because evidence is still pending

control_selections.reason: Support the shoreline and field patterning with a mild contrast increase.
Enable selective color support so the greens and water recover presence without becoming loud.
control_selections.expected_effect: cleaner color separation in vegetation and sea
control_selections.risk_mitigation: lift pastels more than already saturated colors

control_selections.reason: The haze has muted the quieter greens; a selective pastel lift can help them read.
Keep already-bright colors from overshooting while still adding a little support.
Protect the coastline and field hues from drifting while adding color.
control_selections.risk_mitigation: acceptable because realism matters more than force

controls_considered_but_rejected.reason: A haze-specific global or local dehaze family would likely help this image, but it is not available in the current manifest and cannot be selected.
Blocked by manifest and likely to turn the haze/cloud transitions brittle.
Blocked by manifest and too likely to fake the landscape color rather than solve the atmospheric veil.

non_goals: do not pretend crop solves the haze problem
do not harden the cloud edge unnaturally

verification_observations.subject_change_description: The coastline sweep and field patterning read a little more clearly, but the haze still keeps the hill from separating strongly.
verification_observations.background_change_description: Cloud and ridge relationships are slightly cleaner, though the broad atmospheric veil remains the main limiter.
verification_observations.midtone_change_description: Midtones gain a modest amount of hillside structure and shoreline definition but not enough to feel like a materially stronger landscape edit.
verification_observations.highlight_shadow_description: The cloud bank is a bit better controlled, but the upper frame still feels bright and veiled rather than decisively shaped.
verification_observations.color_change_description: Greens and water gain some presence while staying natural, but the scene still looks weather-soft rather than crisply resolved.
verification_observations.artifact_description: No obvious halos or fake-HDR transitions appear, but the image still carries a gray haze ceiling.
verification_observations.crop_dependency_description: Any gain is tonal and color based; the weakness comes from limited haze-removal capability rather than framing.
